value.name: Charlene runs outside
value.description: Charlene rushes out as Micky pauses on the stairs.
evidence: Charlene runs out; Micky pauses on stairs.

value.name: Micky asks to meet George's contact
value.description: Micky says he wants to meet the man George told Charlene about, the one who owns a cab company.
evidence: MICKY (pauses on stairs) I wanna meet that guy George told you about.
[pause] The one with the cab company.

value.name: Charlene agrees silently
value.description: Charlene nods in response to Micky's request.

value.name: Micky leaves down the stairs
value.description: Micky goes down the stairs and disappears from Charlene's view.

value.name: Charlene watches Micky walk away
value.description: Charlene moves to the balcony edge, looks down, and watches Micky walk away from under the porch.
evidence: she runs to the edge of the balcony, looks down, waits, in a moment Micky's back appears from under the porch, walking away.
